prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right attorney depends on the facts of your case, the lawyer’s experience with similar accidents, and how well you work with them. I can help you find a strong lawyer in Houston, but here are practical steps and criteria to use when choosing one:

What to look for
- Experience with car-accident cases (not just general practice). Prefer lawyers who handle similar injuries and insurance disputes.
- Trial experience and a track record of settlements/verdicts. Many cases settle, but you want someone who will go to court if necessary.
- Reputation and peer reviews (Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo, Super Lawyers) and client reviews.
- Clear contingency-fee agreement (typical contingency is ~33%–40% on a contingency basis) and transparent handling of costs.
- Good communication: timely responses and a clear point of contact.
- Access to medical experts and accident reconstructionists when needed.
- Clean disciplinary record (check the State Bar of Texas).

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How long have you handled car-accident cases and how many similar cases have you tried?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What do you estimate my case is worth and why?
- What is your contingency fee and what costs will be deducted?
- How do you communicate with clients and how often will I get updates?
- Can you provide references or examples of past results?

Where to search and verify credentials
- State Bar of Texas lawyer search (disciplinary record)
- Houston Bar Association lawyer referral
- Review sites: Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell, Google reviews
- Local lists (Super Lawyers, Top Rated Lawyers)

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific recovery amount
- Pressure to sign immediately
- No written fee agreement or vague billing language
- Poor reviews citing lack of communication or missed deadlines

If you want, I can:
- Pull together 3–5 well-rated Houston personal injury attorneys who handle car wrecks and match your needs, or
- Walk you through what to bring to a consultation.

Tell me your ZIP code and a couple of case details (severity of injuries, if fault is disputed, whether insurance is involved) and I’ll prepare a short, tailored list.
